proposed_comments.body:
### Split unrelated product and test-infrastructure changes

**Severity:** `high`

This pull request combines Auto Hide Cursor with independent Crop and Lock, Environment Variables, shared UI-test infrastructure, pipeline, documentation, and accessibility changes. Those areas have separate behavior and validation risks, so keeping them together makes the change harder to review, test, roll back, and diagnose. Please split the unrelated work into focused pull requests and keep this change limited to Auto Hide Cursor.
